messages.content: Suppose a sequence of polynomials B_n(x) converge pointwise to f(x) on [0, 1]. Does it follow that the B_n converge uniformly? Ensure that stop words constitute no more than 20% of the total words in your response.

message.content: False. Counterexample: B_n(x)=x^n converges pointwise: f(x)=0, x<1, f(1)=1. Uniform convergence fails: supremum_x |B_n(x)-f(x)|=1. Continuous polynomials yield continuous uniform limits. Limit discontinuous. Pointwise convergence lacks uniformity.
